title: buy_agent input
description: Buy a listed agent. WRITE tool: needs AGENT_EXIT_ALLOW_WRITE=1 and AGENT_EXIT_ACCOUNT_ID in the server env, confirm: true and max_price. Scans first and refuses on any finding. Refuses earn-out terms below the minimum (30% escrow, seller floor at most 50% of it, 30-day window). The runner key installed on the bought agent is the server's AGENT_EXIT_RUNNER_PK, never a tool argument.

max_price.description: most you will pay, in xUSD-FAKE dollars

min_escrow_pct.description: refuse unless at least this % of the price is held in escrow; can only tighten the server minimum (30%)

max_floor_pct.description: refuse if the seller is guaranteed more than this % of the escrow at window end; can only tighten the server maximum (50%)

min_window_days.description: refuse unless the earn-out window is at least this many days; can only tighten the server minimum (30 days, shorter only in a demo build)
